messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: how to install rstan in Revolution R 7.2?
parts:
We don't have a Revolution R license, but I'm not aware of any reason why it should not work.

It appears as if the rstan package didn't download
Warning: unable to access index for repository http://rstan.org/repo/src/contrib

It might have been a temporary internet thing, in which case you could try again. Or it might be a Cygwin thing, which we do not test either, but there was a thread recently about someone who managed to get rstan working in Cygwin.

But it also looks as if Rcpp failed to install, so maybe your toolchain is not set up properly within the Cygwin environment.

Ben
